text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty — page fired: `LB target health degraded` in prod-us-west (severity: P1). Trigger: aws-alb-target-health-check failed > 5m

pagerduty: Escalation: eng-oncall-b has been notified.

eng-oncall-b: Ack. I'm on it, jumping into logs and LB console now.

andrew: seeing increased 502/504 from the ALB logs, health check path `/healthz` returning 502 from a subset of targets.

marta: I'm getting TLS handshake errors in the app logs: `tls: handshake failure` for connections bound for 10.12.42.* targets. Could be cert or dead backend sockets.

netsys: Confirming LB target group shows 40% unhealthy targets in prod-us-west-a. Health reason: "Failed health checks". No recent deploy in the last hour.

eng-oncall-b: Running curl against the LB health endpoint: `curl -vk https://prod-us-west.elb.redwood.ai/healthz` -> TLS handshake fails intermittently, sometimes returns `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway`.

eng-oncall-b: Pushing for failover to backup target group, initiating connection drain on unhealthy targets. Command run: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn tg-abc --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=30`

pagerduty: auto-escalate in 5m if not acknowledged by netsys.

netsys: I'm on the LB console. No config changes in the last 24h. Suspect a network issue between host NICs and the ALB or a recent kernel update on hosts. Pulling host metrics now.

andrew: Host metrics show elevated RSTs and accept queue drops on host-42 and host-47. `ss -s` shows queue overflow.

marta: App process logs show persistent `read: connection reset by peer` right before TLS handshake errors. Could be ephemeral port exhaustion or distro CVE patch?

sre-lead: Rolling a quick mitigation: add a static routing policy to send traffic to alternate AZ (us-west-b) while we fix hosts. Can we update routing policy for the flow?

eng-oncall-b: Initiated routing policy change (canary) to direct 30% traffic to us-west-b. `proxyctl route update --pool prod-us-west --weights a:70,b:30` — monitoring 1m.

customer-success: Several customers pinged support: some API calls failing with 50x, high latency. We're proactively notifying affected customers: sending template (SRE to include ETA).

netsys: After draining bad targets, target health rose to 95% in 2 minutes. TLS handshake failures dropped sharply. Looks like host-side issue causing sockets to be rejected by app processes.

eng-oncall-b: Good. Still seeing a small spike of 502s from one IP range (10.12.42.0/24). I'm going to cordon + reboot host-47 as it shows high orphaned sockets. `kubectl get pods -o wide` shows few pods on that host.

marta: Rebooting host-47 now. Will post progress.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: host-47 drain started by marta.

andrew: Post-reboot host-47 came back healthy, no TLS errors in last 90s. ALB target group stable.

eng-oncall-b: Re-running synthetic checks across regions. All green. Rolling rollback of canary routing: `proxyctl route update --pool prod-us-west --weights a:100,b:0`.

customer-success: Notifying customers update: partial impact in us-west resolved, all regions stable. Template sent to affected list.

sre-lead: Summary for handoff: root cause appears to be host-level socket exhaustion (accept queue overflow) causing TLS handshakes to fail and ALB to mark targets unhealthy. Mitigation: drain/reboot affected hosts, redirect traffic to alternate AZ, adjust kernel/tuning on hosts.

eng-oncall-b: I'll stay on for the next 20m to validate stability, then handoff to netsys for follow-up tuning and postmortem.

netsys: Taking over after 20m. I'll run `sysctl net.core.somaxconn=1024` and adjust `net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog`. Will schedule a coordinated kernel patch window if needed.

incident-bot: PagerDuty — incident acknowledged by eng-oncall-b, status: mitigated.

pagerduty: Incident closed for pagerduty page (manual close by eng-oncall-b).

eng-oncall-b: Filing postmortem draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4213 (will add timeline + action items).

customer-success: Logged affected customer list to the ticket, will follow up with outreach summaries. :white_check_mark:

sre-lead: Action items: 1) kernel/workload tuning 2) add LB health-check diversity (tcp + http) 3) automated detection for accept-queue saturation 4) run capacity test on host pool. Owner assignments in the postmortem.

marta: Marking thread resolved on my end. Thanks all. :pray:
